Darj zail Quranic ibaarat ko khud samjho aur tarjuma karo:
Alhamdulillah, ab aap darj zail Quranic jumloon ko khud samajh aur tarjuma kar sakte hain.

data.text: Naye alfaaz aate jaayein, unhe yaad karte jaayein, taake aane waale maraahil mein aapke liye aasaani ho.
Darj zail misaalein dekhein:

Arabic mein jab kisi cheez ki qasam khaate hain to usse pehle (وَ) lagaya jata hai jise (وَ al-Qasam) kehte hain. Jis lafz ki qasam khaani ho usse pehle (وَ) lagao aur us lafz ki aakhir ki harakat ko kasrah mein badal do.
Ab aap Quran mein aane wali darj zail qasamon ko khud samajh sakte hain.
Agar lafz mein (ال) na ho to mafhoom mein 'any' ya 'a' ka izafa hota hai.
Ab aap in dono Quranic aayaat ko poori tarah khud samajh aur tarjuma kar sakte hain:

items.hinglish: zamane ki qasam, beshak insan ghate mein hai

data.instruction: Darj zail Quranic ayaat mein kis cheez ki qasam khaai gayi hai? Pehle sawal ki pehli misaal ki tarah, har qasam aur jis cheez ki qasam khaai gayi use nishan-zad karein.

Neeche ki aasaan Quranic ibaarat khud samjho aur Tarjuma karo:
Agar lafz ke shuru mein (ال) ho, to (أَيُّهَا) ya (أَنَّهَا) lagaaya jaata hai.

data.instruction: Neeche ki Quranic ayaat se woh hissa highlight karo jahan kisi ko pukara ja raha hai.
